title: Kong AI Gateway: Overview
description: Modelled on the Konnect AI Manager overview page. Source: OpenTelemetry policy on AI Gateway 2.3 -> Grafana LGTM.

panels.title: Key metrics (selected range vs the previous range of the same length)
LLM latency (p95)
panels.description: p95 of gen_ai.server.request.duration: time from request received to response complete, as seen by the gateway.

panels.title: Request count
panels.description: Number of LLM requests (count of gen_ai.server.request.duration).

panels.title: Total token count
panels.description: gen_ai.client.token.usage with gen_ai.token.type=total (input + output).

panels.title: Cached token count
panels.description: gen_ai.token.type=cached_tokens. Stays 0 here: the mock provider returns no cache usage.

panels.title: Error rate
panels.description: Requests whose duration metric carries an error.type, divided by all requests.

panels.title: Costs
panels.description: kong.gen_ai.llm.cost. Computed from input_cost / output_cost ($ per 1M tokens) on each model target.

panels.title: Models
panels.description: Requests by model.

panels.title: Providers
panels.description: Requests by provider.

panels.title: Users (consumers)
panels.description: Requests by AI Consumer. Needs enable_consumer_attribute on the OpenTelemetry policy.

panels.title: Users by tokens
panels.description: Total tokens by AI Consumer. (Konnect shows MCP Server here; see the MCP row below.)

panels.title: Total requests
panels.description: Requests per second, split by oneshot vs stream.

panels.title: LLM latency (p50 / p95 / p99)
panels.description: gen_ai.server.request.duration

panels.title: Error rate
panels.description: Share of requests with an error.type.

panels.title: Tokens per minute
panels.description: Input and output tokens per minute (the 'total' series is left out to avoid double counting).

panels.title: Time to first token (p50 / p95 / p99)
panels.description: gen_ai.server.time_to_first_token.

panels.title: Time per output token (p50 / p95 / p99)
panels.description: gen_ai.server.time_per_output_token.

panels.title: Total costs vs request count
panels.description: Cost (left axis, bars) against request volume (right axis, line).

panels.title: Cost by model
panels.description: Dollars per minute, stacked by model.

panels.title: Success rate and usage by model
panels.description: Per model: request count, success rate and total tokens in the selected range.

targets.expr: 1 - ((sum by (gen_ai_request_model) (increase(gen_ai_server_request_duration_seconds_count{gen_ai_provider_name=~"$provider",gen_ai_request_model=~"$model",kong_auth_consumer_name=~"$consumer",error_type!=""}[$__range]))) / sum by (gen_ai_request_model) (increase(gen_ai_server_request_duration_seconds_count{gen_ai_provider_name=~"$provider",gen_ai_request_model=~"$model",kong_auth_consumer_name=~"$consumer"}[$__range])) or sum by (gen_ai_request_model) (increase(gen_ai_server_request_duration_seconds_count{gen_ai_provider_name=~"$provider",gen_ai_request_model=~"$model",kong_auth_consumer_name=~"$consumer"}[$__range])) * 0)

panels.title: Model usage by user
panels.description: Request rate for each consumer and model pair.

panels.title: Error rate per model
panels.description: Share of requests with an error.type, per model. Series appear once a model has failed at least once.

panels.title: Latency per model (p95)
panels.description: p95 gen_ai.server.request.duration per model.

panels.title: Top MCP servers (tool calls)
panels.description: tools/call count per MCP server (kong.service.name = the AI MCP Server name).

panels.title: Method calls by tool
panels.description: mcp.server.operation.duration count for tools/call, by server and tool.

panels.title: Failing method calls
panels.description: kong.gen_ai.mcp.request.error.count. The mock's run_ci_flaky tool fails about 30% of the time.

panels.title: MCP tool latency (p95)
panels.description: mcp.server.operation.duration for tools/call. slow_budget_report sleeps 1-3 s on purpose.

panels.title: MCP response size (p95)
panels.description: kong.gen_ai.mcp.response.size

panels.title: HTTP responses by status code
panels.description: http.server.request.count by status. 200 = ok, 401 = bad key, 429/529 = provider errors passed back.

panels.title: Kong latency (p95): total / upstream / internal
panels.description: Gateway overhead is 'internal'; the LLM provider is 'upstream'.

panels.title: Control plane connection
panels.description: kong.cp.connection.status: 1 = data plane connected to Konnect.

panels.title: DP certificate expires in
panels.description: kong.dp.cluster.cert.expiry is an absolute timestamp; the panel subtracts now to show the time left on the mTLS certificate to Konnect.

panels.title: Request / response size (avg)
panels.description: Needs enable_bandwidth_metrics.

panels.title: Recent LLM traces (Tempo)
panels.description: Click a trace ID to open the waterfall: a 'kong' request span with a 'chat <model>' child carrying the gen_ai.* attributes.

panels.title: Gateway access logs, errors only (Loki)
panels.description: OTLP access logs from the policy's access_logs endpoint. In 2.3 they are emitted for responses Kong itself produces (for example 401 from a bad key), not for requests proxied to the LLM.

panels.title: Log volume by type (Loki)
panels.description: Runtime (error log) and access log records per interval.

panels.title: Gateway runtime logs (Loki)
panels.description: Kong error/runtime log, exported through logs_endpoint.
